profile.about:
I'm a Software Engineer who loves the challenge of turning complex logic into seamless user experiences. My journey began in the scenic landscapes of Nepal and led me to the fast-paced tech world of India, where I now build enterprise-scale solutions. I specialize in Java/Spring Boot and the modern web stack, optimizing performance, ensuring data compliance, or architecting for the cloud. To me, coding isn't just about syntax; it's about building reliable systems that people can trust.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new places, watching movies, or hiking in the great outdoors. I'm looking forward to connect with fellow developers and industry professionals to exchange ideas, share knowledge, and embark on an incredible journey of growth and innovation.
